title: Weekly Pottery Classes
source_quote: Weekly Ongoing Class: It is a great way to learn and expand your understanding of pottery.
evidence_sentence: The weekly classes page states firing happens in electric kilns and raku kilns as part of the pottery curriculum.
evidence_quote: Firing in 2 different electric kilns, and raku kilns provide a wide range of surface decoration.
summary: Ongoing weekly pottery classes for all levels (beginner to advanced) that include wheel throwing and hand-building, with firing in raku and electric kilns. Classes are $140–$175/month, offered multiple times per week, and have some spots open.
how_to_join: Register online through individual class links; select from Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, or Sunday options.
pay_text: Monthly tuition paid directly to teaching artist
commitment: Ongoing weekly classes, paid monthly; can continue or discontinue anytime
